questions.q: What does the Create Accounting program do?
options: It deletes transactions that are past due
It applies AutoAccounting rules to pending Receivables activity to generate actual journal entries
It only runs once per year at fiscal year-end
It replaces the need for a chart of accounts
questions.explain: Create Accounting processes eligible accounting events and applies AutoAccounting rules to produce the actual subledger journal entries.

questions.q: What is the purpose of draft accounting?
options: To permanently post entries to the General Ledger
To preview what the journal entries would look like without making them final
To automatically reverse incorrect receipts
To generate a customer statement
questions.explain: Draft accounting lets a user spot-check how transactions will account before committing to final, authoritative entries.

questions.q: When the Transfer to General Ledger parameter is set to No, what happens?
options: The transaction is deleted instead of accounted
Create Accounting finalizes entries in the subledger but a separate process is needed later to move them to the GL
The transaction automatically reverts to draft status
No accounting entries are created at all
questions.explain: Setting Transfer to General Ledger to No finalizes the subledger entries but leaves the GL transfer as a separate step to run later.

questions.q: Which of these is a common reason a transaction fails to account?
options: The transaction references a GL account combination that is invalid or disabled
The customer has too many open invoices
The receipt method is set to automatic creation
The transaction was entered through lockbox
questions.explain: An invalid or disabled GL account combination is a common reason Create Accounting rejects a transaction, along with incomplete AutoAccounting rules or a closed period.

questions.q: Why might a company set Transfer to General Ledger to No rather than Yes?
options: Because it is the only way to run draft accounting
To finalize Receivables accounting continuously while controlling exactly when data moves to the GL, often coordinated across subledgers
Because it is required for miscellaneous receipts specifically
Because Yes is not a valid option in Oracle Fusion
questions.explain: Setting the parameter to No gives a company control over the timing of the GL transfer, useful for coordinating when AP, AR, and other subledgers all post together.
